sections.heading: What is Function overloads and implementation signatures?

blocks.text: **Function overloads and implementation signatures** is a compile-time TypeScript concept that erases at emit — the run-time behavior is still JavaScript. Function overloads and implementation signatures treats functions as first-class values with lexical scope and closures. sections.heading: Why Function overloads and implementation signatures matters in production

blocks.text: Senior interviews and on-call debugging both test **Function overloads and implementation signatures** beyond one-line definitions. Production failures here look like silent data corruption, memory growth, type errors at CI, or async ordering bugs — not syntax errors. If you know JavaScript, use the comparison table to transfer intuition instead of memorizing rules in isolation.
